stations.title: AI DATA ANALYTICS DASHBOARDS AND ALIGNMENT RESEARCH

tagDescriptions.OBJ-200: Internal project designation for the Lymphedema Treatment Act Medicare DME qualification engine built for Durable Medical Goods compliance workflows.
tagDescriptions.GraphRAG LLM: Property-graph retrieval-augmented generation pipeline that grounds LLM determinations in structured Medicare statutory rules rather than unconstrained free-text recall.
tagDescriptions.8-Hop Lineage: Multi-step graph traversal tracing up to 8 relational hops across diagnosis codes, clinical measurements, compression garment classes, and coverage exceptions.
tagDescriptions.17 Cat / 18 Edge: Domain ontology schema spanning 17 medical/policy node categories connected by 18 typed regulatory and clinical relationship edge types.
tagDescriptions.OBJ-04: Unit identifier for Luis's autonomous Digital Twin persona and floating DOOM_HEAD holographic companion operating inside Freeman Alley.
tagDescriptions.Philosophy + MF DOOM: Curated training and alignment corpus blending undergraduate Philosophy & Religion coursework with MF DOOM's intricate multi-syllabic rhyme schemes and cadence.
tagDescriptions.Finetuned LLM: Custom instruction-tuned and style-aligned language model engineered to reason about systems architecture and philosophy in a signature lyrical voice.
tagDescriptions.Twitter & LinkedIn: Live social deployment bindings enabling the Digital Twin persona to publish, reply, and interact autonomously across X/Twitter and LinkedIn channels.
tagDescriptions.Bayesian SSM: Bayesian State Space Model using Kalman filtering and Hidden Markov regime switching to track unobserved equilibrium spreads and time-varying hedge ratios.
tagDescriptions.$50K TopStepXFA: Validated under live market risk constraints to pass a $50,000 TopStep Express Funded Account (XFA) quantitative trading combine evaluation.
tagDescriptions.Mean Reversion: Statistical execution strategy that enters counter-trend positions when cointegrated asset spreads deviate beyond dynamically calibrated z-score thresholds.
tagDescriptions.Cointegration: Econometric stationarity verification (Augmented Dickey-Fuller p < 0.05) ensuring paired financial instruments share a stable long-run equilibrium linear combination.
tagDescriptions.bge-large-en-v1.5: Frozen BAAI bge-large-en-v1.5 transformer backbone used to extract high-resolution semantic representations from raw resume and job-description text.
tagDescriptions.1,024-D Embeddings: Dense 1,024-dimensional L2-normalized feature vectors capturing deep technical skill, domain experience, and role-fit geometry for downstream classical ML classifiers.
tagDescriptions.LinearSVC Heads: Lightweight, dynamically swappable Linear Support Vector Machine classification heads trained on top of frozen embeddings for sub-millisecond role scoring.
tagDescriptions.9 Job Roles: Multi-target classification suite evaluating candidate fit across 9 distinct engineering, data science, and quantitative analytics role profiles.
tagDescriptions.Live Analytics: Real-time telemetry ingestion and visual dashboard pipelines that transform raw operational and unstructured data streams into actionable metrics.
tagDescriptions.Structured Context: Schema-validated knowledge graphs and typed context packets distilled from noisy datasets so downstream AI agents operate on verifiable ground truth.
tagDescriptions.Agent Swarms: Multi-agent orchestration architectures where specialized autonomous workers coordinate tasks, share state, and verify outputs across shared telemetry buses.
tagDescriptions.Alignment Research: Empirical guardrails, objective-function auditing, and deterministic evaluation harnesses ensuring autonomous agent swarms stay locked to human intent.
tagDescriptions.Chained AI Models: Sequential and DAG-based multi-model pipelines where outputs from retrieval, reasoning, vision, and audio models feed deterministically into downstream stages.
tagDescriptions.Content Production: Automated multi-modal media synthesis generating synchronized copy, visual assets, 3D textures, and styled layouts from structured creative briefs.
tagDescriptions.Code Generation: Specification-driven agentic coding workflows that synthesize, test, and verify production software modules against strict architectural contracts.
tagDescriptions.Workflow Execution: End-to-end task automation engines connecting LLM tool-calling and schema validation to live APIs, databases, and build pipelines.
tagDescriptions.Transformers & CNNs: Hybrid deep learning stacks combining self-attention sequence/vision Transformers (ViT) with Convolutional Neural Networks for spatial and temporal feature extraction.
tagDescriptions.Autoencoders: Variational and denoising autoencoder architectures trained to compress high-dimensional inputs into compact latent manifolds for anomaly detection and data mining.
tagDescriptions.Diffusion & 3D: Latent diffusion and image-to-3D generative pipelines used to synthesize custom textures, holographic visuals, and rigged 3D assets.
tagDescriptions.Audio Cloning: Neural speech synthesis and zero-shot voice cloning models trained to generate expressive character dialogue and custom vocal stems.
